lines.text: Before the Passover Feast, Jesus loved His own to the very end, and the devil had put betrayal into Judas's heart.
Jesus laid aside His outer garments, wrapped a towel around His waist, poured water into a jar, and began washing the disciples' feet.
Peter asked whether Jesus would wash his feet, then said, "Never shall You wash my feet!"
Peter then asked Jesus to wash his hands and his head as well, and Jesus said not all of them were clean.
Jesus said that since He had washed their feet, they should wash one another's feet, because no servant is greater than his king.
